summary: Phase 5 HRMS testing (Team Attendance Today, Holiday Calendar, Payroll holiday credit, Expense REJECT email). Backend 7/7 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_hrms_phase5.py: (1) GET /api/hr/attendance/today returned counts {in_office:0, checked_out:1, on_leave:0, missing:7, total:8} (sum==total) and Rahul Verma EMP-0001 checked_out with selfie_url. (2) GET /api/hr/holidays?year=2026 includes seeded 2026-08-15 Independence Day and 2026-10-20 Diwali. (3) POST duplicate 2026-08-15 -> 400. (4) POST 2026-12-25 Christmas -> 200 with id, GET confirms present, DELETE by id -> 200, GET confirms removed. (5) Employee GET /holidays 200; employee POST -> 403. (6) POST /api/hr/payroll/generate {employee_id:5a171b36..., month:8, year:2026} -> holiday_days=1, effective_working_days=1.5 (0 present + 1 half*0.5 + 1 holiday). (7) Expense reject email: created draft expense EXP-*, uploaded PNG via /expense/{id}/upload-document, submitted, admin PUT /expense/{id}/reject {role:'hr',reason:'test phase5'} -> 200; backend.err.log contained 'Expense Rejected' within 45s. Frontend (Playwright, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): Admin -> /hr -> Today Attendance renders team-attendance-today with 4 count cards (team-count-in_office=0, checked_out=1, on_leave=0, missing=7); 8 team-row-* rows; Rahul Verma row shows CHECKED OUT with selfie pointing to /api/uploads/attendance_selfies/73dd3fc4-*.jpg; clicking team-count-checked_out filters to 1 row; refresh-team-btn works. Holiday Calendar renders with Independence Day + Diwali cards; add-holiday-btn dialog with holiday-date-input+holiday-name-input+save-holiday-btn added 'Test Fest' 2026-11-01 which appeared as a card; delete-holiday- (bound via data-testid) removed only Test Fest and left Independence Day + Diwali intact. Employee -> /employee -> Attendance tab: upcoming-holidays-card shows '15 Aug — Independence Day' and '20 Oct — Diwali' chips. Regression: employee Payslips tab: August 2026 shows 'Days worked: 1.5 / 26' (matches holiday credit) and download-payslip-btn present. Admin auto-run payroll card was untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: Holiday delete endpoint proved idempotent-ish (DELETE 200 for existing id); backend does not appear to error on unknown id — main agent may want to explicitly return 404 for unknown holiday ids for cleaner API contract (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Backend: created + deleted 2026-12-25 TEST Christmas holiday; created + submitted + rejected one expense EXP-* under employee@airyatra.com (status now REJECTED, remains in db). Frontend: added + deleted 2026-11-01 'Test Fest' holiday (cleaned up). During initial Playwright pass, an over-broad selector accidentally deleted the seeded Independence Day holiday via its testid; immediately restored via API POST /api/hr/holidays (new id eda60f08-580b-4b99-a357-87b2be3403a1) — verified present in final state. Final holiday list for 2026: Independence Day (2026-08-15), Diwali (2026-10-20). No other seed data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response uses 'access_token'. Expense create requires 'title' field (400/500 without it). Expense receipt upload endpoint is POST /api/hr/expense/{id}/upload-document (not /upload-receipt or /receipt). Expense reject payload: {role:'hr', reason:'...'}. Backend email log lines to search in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: 'Expense Rejected', 'Expense Approved', 'Expense Reimbursed', 'New Leave Application'. Frontend: HolidayCalendar delete buttons use data-testid='delete-holiday-<uuid>' — DO NOT rely on .first inside an ancestor locator because the container often includes all cards; map testid->text via page.evaluate() querying [data-testid^='holiday-card-'] or nearest ancestor. Attendance/today counts summed equal total. Employee upcoming-holidays-card lives in the Attendance tab. Independence Day new id after restore: eda60f08-580b-4b99-a357-87b2be3403a1.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects. The transient 'Independence Day removed' during first Playwright run was caused by my test selector (locator('div', has_text='Test Fest').filter(...).locator('[data-testid^=delete-holiday-]').first) matching an outer container that also enclosed the Independence Day card, so .first picked Independence Day's delete button. The application itself binds each delete-holiday-<id> button correctly to its own holiday (proven by second Playwright run using page.evaluate() to explicitly map testid->text, then clicking the Test Fest testid which removed only Test Fest). Cleanup: restored Independence Day via API immediately, verified in final admin+employee UI passes.
